sponsors.name: Visit Rwanda
sponsors.verdict: Paid for by a government that UN experts say has 3,000–4,000 troops fighting alongside M23 rebels in eastern Congo.

source.name: NBA Communications (pr.nba.com): BAL and Rwanda Development Board multi-year extension
source.note: 'Visit Rwanda will continue to be showcased on BAL team uniforms and at the BAL Combine' - league-wide branding on all 12 teams' uniforms, not a club-level shirt deal.
